description: P1: landing page, aesthetic, create/join, lobby and room shell, ephemeral state, full signaling server core. Must go first; all later features depend on it.
steps: Do plan.md tasks P1-1 through P1-9 in order, reading design.md sections 2-7, 13-15 as needed.
Decide font path (google vs local woff2) and commit it (review note 1).
Record resolved dependency versions in findings for the README.
acceptance_criteria: Root typecheck, lint, test, build pass; server typecheck, test, build pass
Smoke script v1 exits 0 against the background server (create, peek, password join, late-join snapshot, migration, invalid_state, 403 origin, 1009, idle rule)
Hero heading and subtitle match brief exactly
verification: npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test; npm run build
npm --prefix signaling-server run typecheck; npm --prefix signaling-server test; npm --prefix signaling-server run build
start server in background, npm --prefix signaling-server run smoke, stop server
findings:
FONT DECISION: next/font/google (Nunito body, Quicksand display; CSS vars --font-body/--font-display, fallback stack ui-rounded/Segoe UI/system-ui). npm run build passed with network available, so no woff2 was committed. Fonts are fetched at build time: an offline build will fail, in which case switch src/app/fonts.ts to next/font/local with woff2 under src/app/fonts/ (same variable names).
RESOLVED VERSIONS (exact, for README): root deps next 16.4.6, react 19.3.1, react-dom 19.3.1, motion 14.14.0 (import from 'motion/react' works), lucide-react 1.77.0; root dev: tailwindcss 3.4.19, postcss 8.5.33, autoprefixer 10.7.0, typescript 5.9.3 (7.x exists but 5.9.3 chosen for tooling compatibility), eslint 9.39.5, eslint-config-next 16.4.6, vitest 3.2.7, jsdom 26.1.0, @testing-library/react 16.3.3, concurrently 10.0.7, @types/react 19.3.0, @types/react-dom 19.3.0, @types/node 22.20.5. signaling-server deps: ws 8.23.0, @types/ws 8.18.2, esbuild 0.28.2, tsx 4.23.15, typescript 5.9.3, vitest 3.2.7, @types/node 22.20.5. Node 24.20 / npm 11.19 used.
ENV QUIRK: this machine's Application Control policy blocks rollup's native .node file, so both package.json files carry overrides {rollup: npm:@rollup/wasm-node@4.68.8} (vitest/vite use it). Keep it or remove it if native rollup works on the target machine; README may mention it.
NEXT 16 NOTES: lint is 'eslint .' with flat eslint.config.mjs (eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals + typescript; signaling-server ignored). Route params are a Promise (room/[code]/page.tsx awaits it). next build rewrote tsconfig include (.next/dev/types). next-env.d.ts is committed. Dynamic route /room/BAD still returns HTTP 200 with the not-found UI because loading.tsx streams first (soft 404).
FILE DEVIATIONS from design tree: src/lib/theme/useTheme.tsx (has JSX), src/lib/room/RoomController.ts (non-React lifecycle owner used by RoomProvider; owns resume-then-peek, attemptKey Strict Mode guard, deferred leave), src/components/Providers.tsx, src/components/Logo.tsx, src/components/landing/LandingPage.tsx, src/components/room/{RoomView,ProfilePicker,ThemePicker}.tsx, src/test/fakeTransport.ts, src/lib/utils/useIsClient.ts. SignalingTransport gained onLocalError(handler) (dropped-send notices). shared/playback.ts currently has expectedPosition only (applyCommand arrives in P2).
SERVER STATE FOR LATER PHASES: Room (signaling-server/src/room.ts) already has endShare(), freezePlayback() before host:changed, migrateHost, shareSession, mediaRev, queue/game/chat fields, addSystemChat (join/leave lines already broadcast). handlers/index.ts dispatch() has a default case replying bad_request 'not supported yet': add cases for media:set, playback:command, local:ready, media:ended/error, queue:*, share:*, rtc:signal, chat:*, game:* in later phases. Conn/HandlerContext are in src/connection.ts; test helpers in signaling-server/test/helpers.ts (makeCtx/connect/send/drop with FakeClock and FakeSocket). room.join()/resume() accept a ref so the requester copy of room:joined carries it. parseGameAction is a stub returning null (fill in P6); parseClientMessage already validates every client message type, and game:action is shape-checked later by the handler.
CLIENT STATE FOR LATER PHASES: roomReducer already applies media:state, playback:state, queue:updated, chat:message/typing, game:state to snapshot. Sidebar currently renders only People and MobileTabBar only Watch|People (add tabs as features land). MediaStage renders the empty state only. Typing expiry runs from RoomProvider every 1 s. useRoom(selector) selectors must return stable references.
VERIFICATION RUN: root typecheck, lint, test (93 tests, 9 files), build; server typecheck, test (49 tests), build all pass. Smoke (28 checks) passes against dist/server.js started in background with ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://smoke.test TRUST_PROXY_HOPS=0 HOST_GRACE_MS=500 SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS=100 IDLE_MS=1000 PORT=8791, run with SMOKE_URL=ws://127.0.0.1:8791 SMOKE_ORIGIN=http://smoke.test. Smoke covers health, create, peek, password join (none/wrong/right), bad resume token, late-join snapshot, create-while-joined invalid_state, not_host, settings broadcast, host migration (timeout), transfer, kick (4001), 403 origin, 1009 oversize frame, bad JSON, idle rule. next start served / with the exact hero heading and subtitle (checked in HTML). Landing UI was not opened in a real browser (P8 optional check).
WINDOWS SHELL TIP: output of Start-Process inside the tool can be swallowed; write results to a file from a .ps1 script and read it back. Do not taskkill node while next build runs (leaves .next/lock).
